preconditions.description: The number of forbidden prefix products n is between 0 and m-1, and m is between 1 and 200000.

preconditions.expression: forbidden_products == [] or (len(forbidden_products) == n and all(0 <= x < m for x in forbidden_products))
preconditions.description: If n is non-zero, the list of forbidden prefix products contains exactly n distinct integers between 0 and m-1.

postconditions.expression: all(0 <= x < m for x in sequence)
postconditions.description: Each element in the sequence is an integer between 0 and m-1, inclusive.
All prefix products of the sequence modulo m are distinct.

postconditions.expression: all(product not in forbidden_products for product in prefix_products)
postconditions.description: No prefix product modulo m appears as an element of the input list of forbidden prefix products.
The length of the sequence is k.
